migration.strategy: Add nullable declaredAgeAtCourseStart; preserve the existing DOB and let legacy rows begin with a null declared age.

reopenAssertions: The prior DOB survives the additive schema upgrade.
The new declared-age column is null for a legacy DOB-backed record.
A fixture record changed to age-only persists with an empty DOB and declared age 17 after close and reopen.
Student create, batch-create, edit and list queries include the declared-age field.
compatibility: npm run verify passed the repository's 0.1.0 compatibility fixture (22 rows).
privacy: Only synthetic fixtures and aggregate test results were used; no private roster images, OCR text or personal data are included.
